description: This file defines the interface and class implementations for a version 2 reporter in the Playwright testing framework, including methods for handling test events, reporting, and output streaming.

classes.name: ReporterV2Wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that adapts a Reporter to the ReporterV2 interface, handling deferred output and event forwarding.

methods.name: wrapReporterAsV2
methods.description: Wraps a Reporter or ReporterV2 instance as a ReporterV2, returning the original if already version 2.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a Reporter instance.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onConfigure
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the reporter.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test suite, flushing deferred events.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output, deferring if necessary.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error output, deferring if necessary.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the test run.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test step.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step.

methods.name: ReporterV2Wrapper.printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates if the reporter prints to stdio.
